scriptSegments.narration: Seventy-nine percent of you locked in Option B—while the fourteen percent running Excel audits got breached by Tuesday.

Developers spin up containers in seconds, turning quarterly spreadsheets into fiction on Day Two. And banning IoT failed the moment facilities plugged a cellular LTE badge reader into corporate switching.

Real asset defense runs on three automated pillars: Continuous Cloud and Network Discovery, Policy-as-Code Data Tagging the instant new storage spawns, and Zero-Trust Micro-Segmentation between every tier. Even if a rogue lobby device gets compromised today, automated segmentation walls choke its lateral blast radius to zero.
In 2023, MGM Resorts suffered over $100 million in disruption when attackers weaponized sprawling hybrid identities across interconnected enterprise systems.
Season Two begins now: NovaPay sees all 1,400 assets, nine critical bugs flash red, and you have $100K before Friday. Which bug dies first?
